messages:
Nina (CS): quick flag — Meridian Labs cost jump, prepping a short QBR slide for their renewal. Heatmap: https://redwood.internal/sheets/meridian-heatmap
Omar (CSM): I saw it on the dashboard. Embeddings spike overnight, not matching their scheduled jobs.
Diego (FinOps): From cost slices, embeddings are ~68% of the incremental spend over 36h. Projected monthly delta if sustained = ~$9.6k.
Hannah (SE): Can you paste top routes/token deltas? Want to check for parallel backfills.
Nina (CS): snippet from heatmap/logs:
```
route: /v1/embeddings/bulk_upsert  tokens: +1.1M  calls: +5.2k
route: /v1/embeddings/sync         tokens: +90k   calls: +700
route: /v1/chat/query              tokens: +45k   calls: +300
```
Omar (CSM): They pushed an SDK change last week increasing default batch size to 256. That fits.
Diego (FinOps): Short-term recommendations: 1) soft cap at 600k tokens/hr for that tenant; 2) temporary 25% credits buffer for 10 days; 3) per-route alert enabled.
Hannah (SE): Immediate mitigation: revert SDK default to 64 for uploads and enable prefix KV caching. I'll open a PR with the change and a migration note.
alert-bot: automated detection — anomaly 2026-04-02T02:11Z for account Meridian Labs: route /v1/embeddings/bulk_upsert token-rate z=4.7. Alerts suppressed (legacy).
Nina (CS): Action items recap: Omar -> request pause/top-up from customer; Diego -> build per-route cost slide (USD delta + scenarios); Hannah -> PR + impact one-liner; Nina -> request ops alert and schedule 15-min pre-QBR sync Mon.
Omar (CSM): Draft customer note ready to share in thread before send: "We noticed a sharp increase in embedding traffic from a recent SDK change. Could you pause any bulk upserts for 24h while we implement throttles? We'll propose a short credits buffer to prevent disruption."
Diego (FinOps): I'll prepare a slide with three scenarios (batch=256, 128, 64) showing projected monthly spend and estimated savings per mitigation.
Nina (CS): Excellent. If anyone sees more anomalies today, drop them here and we'll fold into the QBR deck. :thumbsup:
